svg.title: 01 Research
svg.desc: Chapter 1. I research security for the post-quantum era. My doctoral research explores federated learning that every participant can verify and that remains secure against quantum adversaries. A federated network on a lattice: participants send updates, an intrusion is caught at the checkpoint, and every honest participant verifies the result.

g.text: POST-QUANTUM CRYPTOGRAPHY · FEDERATED LEARNING · INTRUSION DETECTION
My doctoral research explores federated learning that
every participant can verify and that remains secure
INTRUSIONS CAUGHT · RESULTS VERIFIED BY ALL
